title: A sync cache-hit join can strand a pending async job forever
author: NamanSoni78

gist.summary: Fixed a media-generation job getting stuck as pending when a synchronous request finds its result in the cache after the job's alarm was interrupted. The cache-hit path now marks the original async record as succeeded, records its completion time, and schedules an alarm for its TTL. The synchronous caller receives the cached result but is not added as an owner of the async job.
